requirements.title: THIS_IMAGE COARRAY, DIM, and TEAM restrictions
requirements.definition: COARRAY shall be a coarray of any type with allocation and rightmost-part-ref restrictions; DIM shall be an integer scalar in the range one through the corank of COARRAY; TEAM shall be scalar TEAM_TYPE identifying the current or an ancestor team, and COARRAY shall be established in that team.

requirements.title: THIS_IMAGE result characteristics
requirements.definition: The THIS_IMAGE result is default integer; without COARRAY or with DIM it is scalar, and with COARRAY and no DIM it is rank one with size equal to the corank of COARRAY.

requirements.title: THIS_IMAGE result values
requirements.definition: THIS_IMAGE returns the invoking image index for the specified or current team, or cosubscript values for a COARRAY and optional DIM.
